name: IDX Exchange Orchestrator Bridge
description: Routes incoming WhatsApp messages to the IDX Exchange multi-agent orchestrator (property search, market stats, recommendations, RAG knowledge).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the IDX Exchange project on this machine (e.g. /Users/you/OpenClaw-Based Multi-Agent). Required -- this plugin runs from ~/.openclaw/extensions, outside the project, so it has no other way to find it.
